# FG-GIT-0016

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`merge-blocked`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-blocked.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_incomplete_listing_logs_one_warn_with_its_reason` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プッシュは反映されましたが、プッシュしたコミットの一覧を最後まで記録できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The push was applied, but the list of the commits it brought could not be recorded in full. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Push sudah diterapkan, tetapi daftar commit yang dibawanya tidak dapat dicatat seluruhnya. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

After an applied push, forge lists the commits it introduced (every commit no ref reached before the push, against a snapshot of the ref tips read before receive-pack started; ADR-0024 §8.3) to write one `push_commits` row per commit for the committer rule. The listing stopped early or could not run: `reason=cap` (more than 50 000 new commits, forge_core::MAX_PUSHED_COMMITS), `deadline` (the 30 s bound), `snapshot_failed` (the ref snapshot before the push failed, see `cause_code`), `git_failed` (rev-list failed, see `cause_code`). The push and its audit row are fine; the audit row carries `push_commits_incomplete: true` and the commits not listed have no row, so a merge request whose range holds one has unknown committers (`committers_unknown`, `push_record_missing`) and counts no approval. Also logged by the merge job (`event=forge.review.merge_commit_unattributed`, `reason=merge_pushers_unknown:<why>` with `merge_id`): a merge or squash commit is attributed to the requester and every pusher of the merged range, and when those pushers cannot be told (`push_record_missing`, `range_too_long`, `git_failed`, `db_failed`, `deadline`, `merge_lock_lost`) the merge commit gets no row at all (fail closed). The user never sees this code: the push or the merge itself succeeded.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One warn event per push with `error_code`, `request_id` (the push's), `reason`, `listed` (rows written), `refs` (refs in the snapshot), `listing_ms`, `repo_id`, and `cause_code` for snapshot_failed / git_failed. The same request id's `repository.pushed` audit row has `push_commits_incomplete: true`. Every push also logs `event=forge.git.push_commits_listed` (info) with `refs`, `listed`, `listing_ms`: rising `listing_ms` with `refs` points at a repository with very many refs.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing is wrong with the repository. A merge request blocked by it (merge-blocked runbook, `committers_unknown`) is unblocked by giving the commits new ids — the author amends or runs `git rebase --force-rebase` and pushes (a plain push of the same commits writes no row: they are no longer new). For an import or a huge push whose pushers are known, an administrator may backfill rows with the approved procedure in runbook merge-blocked.
